name: Camping Sunnawirt
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Sunnawirt is nestled in the municipality of Heiterwang in the Außerfern region. Embraced by scenic meadows and alpine forests, it offers a peaceful retreat for nature lovers. Sanitary facilities are impeccably maintained. Nearby Lake Plansee invites swimming and sailing, while scenic mountain trails cater to hikers and cyclists. In winter, the ski domains of Zugspitze and Berwang are within swift reach.
